current_case_scope: adjacent paved shoulder, opposed oncoming vehicle, simulator ClearNight request

triggers.statutory_condition: one-half hour after sunset to one-half hour before sunrise
needed_original_evidence: Dated local civil clock and timezone for every original tick
Location-specific sunset and sunrise event source
Tick-to-clock synchronization and uncertainty at interval boundaries
triggers.acceptance_guard: Do not infer this trigger from CARLA sun altitude or weather label alone.

triggers.statutory_condition: insufficient light or unfavorable atmosphere, with persons and vehicles not clearly discernible at 1000 feet
needed_original_evidence: Controlled poor-light or atmosphere source in original world
Decoded original viewpoint evidence of discernibility with exposure and uncertainty
triggers.acceptance_guard: Weather fog or a visibility flag alone does not establish discernibility.

triggers.statutory_condition: direction by an official traffic control device
needed_original_evidence: Source-identified official device and applicable direction
Original device placement, state, visibility and ego encounter
Frame-linked device state and independent review
triggers.acceptance_guard: An arbitrary sign or authored annotation is not evidence of an official applicable direction.
